pages.title: ORSA RH-5
pages.text: Electric room heat. No fuel, oxygen or Thermal Core.

pages.title: Power Limit
pages.text: Starts at $(bold)5 kW$(); the slider sets 0 (off) to $(bold)50 kW$(). Higher limits warm faster and need more power.$(br2)It only draws what the target needs: 20°C, or the thermostat's.

pages.title: With Fuel Heaters
pages.text: Electric heat runs first; fuel heaters cover any shortfall.$(br2)PIXIE oxygen outranks it. Lights and furnaces are cut before it is.

pages.title: Rapid Heating
pages.text: A Diamond Heater with a capacitor makes about $(bold)12 kW$(). An RH-5 at 50 kW gives about $(bold)4.2x$() that.
$(danger)It drains cells fast:$() one full cell lasts 10 s at 50 kW; four last 40 s.$(br2)Power limited means the grid can't supply what you asked for.

pages.title: Vacuum
pages.text: In vacuum only 25% of the heat you pay for reaches the walls. Insulation lowers steady demand.$(br2)The screen shows air and structure temperature separately.
Iron, copper, glass and a redstone block. Link it with the Binder.
